description: This file defines a database migration class for OrangeHRM, specifically for version 5.8.0. It manages schema modifications such as updating column types and foreign key constraints, particularly fixing issues with currency ID columns and related foreign keys. It also interacts with language string helpers to insert or update language-specific strings during migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class for managing database schema migrations specific to OrangeHRM version 5.8.0, handling schema adjustments, foreign key fixes, and language string updates during the upgrade process.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the main migration logic, including schema introspection, fixing column issues, and updating language strings.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Fixes inconsistencies in 'currency_id' columns, adjusts foreign keys, and enforces character set and collation standards.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys that reference the 'hs_hr_currency_type' table which conflicts need to be fixed.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops specified conflicting foreign key constraints to allow schema modifications.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Recreates foreign keys after schema corrections.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object for executing raw SQL.

methods.name: disableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in the database to allow schema modifications without constraint errors.

methods.name: enableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key checks after schema modifications are complete.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the language string helper object for managing language strings.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to match the migration version.
